input.command: cd /workspace && wc -l dotenv/*.py tests/*.py && ls -la dotenv tests .yecoding
cd /workspace && cat dotenv/variables.py && echo '=====PARSER=====' && cat dotenv/parser.py

cd /workspace && grep -n "parse_variables\|resolve_variables\|interpolate\|_posix_variable" -r dotenv tests --include=*.py && echo '=== DIFF ===' && git status --short 2>/dev/null; git diff 2>/dev/null | head -60
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /workspace && sed -n '1,120p' dotenv/main.py && echo '...' && sed -n '225,270p' dotenv/main.py

cd /workspace && grep -n "" dotenv/variables.py | sed -n '1,15p;66,86p' && echo '=== tests ===' && grep -n "def test_\|class " tests/test_acceptance.py && echo '=== files ===' && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './.yecoding/*' | sort

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
from dotenv.variables import parse_variables
for s in ["literal", "pre-${X}-post", "${X}${Y}", "A=one", "B=${A}"]:
    print(repr(s), "->", list(parse_variables(s)))
EOF

cd /workspace && pwd && ls -la && echo '=== tree ===' && find . -type f -not -path './.yecoding/*' -not -path '*/__pycache__/*' | sort && echo '=== git ===' && (git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>&1 || echo 'no git')

cd /workspace && echo '=== variables.py (numbered, non-blank) ===' && grep -nE "^(_posix_variable|class |def |    def )" dotenv/variables.py && echo '=== main.py symbols ===' && grep -nE "^(class |def |    def )|parse_variables|resolve_variables" dotenv/main.py && echo '=== tests ===' && grep -nE "^(class |    def )|import|parse_variables|parse_stream|dotenv_values|DotEnv\(" tests/test_acceptance.py
cd /workspace && cat dotenv/__init__.py && echo '=== parser.py symbols ===' && grep -nE "^(class |def )" dotenv/parser.py
